user.title: Add Discord Hub
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant talks to Discord. A bot can do everything (channels, forum posts, managing messages), a webhook can only send into one channel.

bot.title: Add a bot
bot.description: Create an application with a bot in the Discord Developer Portal, copy the bot token from the “Bot” page and invite the bot to your server. The token is stored only in Home Assistant.

webhook.title: Add a webhook
webhook.description: In Discord open the channel settings, then “Integrations”, “Webhooks” and copy the webhook address. The address contains a secret and is stored only in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew access
reauth_confirm.description: Discord rejects the saved access. Please enter the current bot token or webhook address.

reconfigure.title: Change access
reconfigure.description: Enter the new bot token or webhook address. It must belong to the same bot or webhook.

error.invalid_auth: Discord rejects this token. Please copy the bot token again from the Developer Portal.
error.cannot_connect: Discord cannot be reached. Please try again in a moment.
error.invalid_webhook: This is not a working webhook address. Please copy the whole address again from the channel settings.

abort.already_configured: This bot or webhook is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This access belongs to a different bot or webhook than the one set up.

user.title: Choose a server
user.description: The bot is a member of several servers. Choose the one with the channel.

channel.title: Add a channel
channel.description: Server: {guild}. Text, announcement, voice, forum and media channels are offered. The channel gets a notify entity for sending.

abort.cannot_connect: Discord cannot be reached. Please try again in a moment.
abort.no_guilds: The bot is not on any server yet. Invite it with the OAuth2 link from the Developer Portal first.
abort.forbidden: The bot may not list the channels of this server.
abort.no_channels: There is no further channel to add on this server.

user.title: Direct messages to a user
user.description: The bot can only write to users who share a server with it. Copy the user ID in Discord (developer mode, right click on the user, “Copy user ID”).

error.invalid_user: This is not a valid user ID.

user.title: Choose a server
user.description: The bot is a member of several servers. Choose the one for the command.

command.title: Add a command
command.description: Server: {guild}. The command appears as /name in Discord and fires an event in Home Assistant. Options: one per line as name:type:description, with a ? after the name for optional ones and a choice in square brackets, for example mode:text:Operating mode [auto|on|off]. Types: text, integer, number, switch, user, channel. Who may use it: list user or role IDs or allow everyone. A reply is sent at once. Without one the bot shows “thinking” until your automation answers with discord_hub.respond (after 10 seconds it says “Done”).

data.name: Name (without the slash)
data.ephemeral: Reply visible only to the user
data.everyone: Everyone on the server may use it

reconfigure.title: Edit command
reconfigure.description: Changes reach Discord at once. Options: one per line as name:type:description, with a ? after the name for optional ones.

data.name: Name (without the slash)
data.ephemeral: Reply visible only to the user
data.everyone: Everyone on the server may use it

error.invalid_name: The name may only have lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32 characters).
error.invalid_options: An option is not valid. Use name:type:description per line, with the types text, integer, number, switch, user or channel.
error.too_many_options: A command can have at most 5 options.
error.invalid_ids: User and role IDs consist of digits only.
error.already_exists: This command already exists on this server.
error.no_permission: Say who may use the command: add users or roles, allow everyone, or set allowed users in the options of the bot.

member.title: Watch a member
member.description: Server: {guild}. Copy the user ID in Discord (developer mode, right-click the user, "Copy User ID"). You will see whether the member is in a voice channel. Status and activity are available when "Track member status" is on in the bot's options (this needs the "Presence Intent" in the Developer Portal).

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Sends a message with text, embeds and files into the channel, the thread or the direct messages. Returns the message ID.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text of the message (up to 2000 characters). User, role and channel mentions like <@123> work.

embeds.name: Embeds
embeds.description: A list of embeds with title, description, color (#RRGGBB), url, author, footer, thumbnail, image, fields and timestamp.

files.name: Files
files.description: Images and videos to attach: a list of local paths, web addresses, camera entities (a snapshot) or media sources. An entry can also be an object with path, url, camera or media, plus filename and spoiler.

reply_to.name: Reply to
reply_to.description: ID of a message in the same channel that this message answers.

thread_id.name: Thread
thread_id.description: ID of a thread in this channel. The message then goes into the thread.

allow_everyone.name: Allow @everyone
allow_everyone.description: Lets @everyone and @here in the text ping everybody. Users and roles can always be mentioned.

username.name: Name shown
username.description: Webhooks only: the name shown for this message.

avatar_url.name: Avatar address
avatar_url.description: Webhooks only: the picture shown for this message.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Buttons under the message: a list with label, custom_id, style (primary, secondary, success, danger or link), url (for link), emoji and disabled. A click fires the event discord_hub_button. An empty list removes the buttons. Needs a bot that listens to Discord.

forum_post.name: Forum post
forum_post.description: Creates a new thread in a forum channel. With “One thread per day” only the first call of the day creates a thread, later calls with the same key write into it. Returns the thread ID, the message ID and whether the thread is new.

thread_name.name: Thread name
thread_name.description: Title of the new thread (up to 100 characters).

message.name: Message
message.description: The text of the first message.

embeds.name: Embeds
embeds.description: A list of embeds, as for “Send message”.

files.name: Files
files.description: Images and videos to attach, as for “Send message”.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Forum tags by name or ID. A webhook needs the IDs (see “List forum tags”).

daily.name: One thread per day
daily.description: Reuses today's thread of the same key instead of creating a new one. If the thread was deleted, a new one is created.

key.name: Key
key.description: Tells the daily threads of one forum apart, for example per sensor or per camera.

allow_everyone.name: Allow @everyone
allow_everyone.description: Lets @everyone and @here in the text ping everybody.

username.name: Name shown
username.description: Webhooks only: the name shown for this post.

avatar_url.name: Avatar address
avatar_url.description: Webhooks only: the picture shown for this post.

edit_message.name: Edit message
edit_message.description: Changes the text or the embeds of a message sent by this bot or webhook.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: ID of the message to change.

message.name: Message
message.description: The new text. An empty text removes it.

embeds.name: Embeds
embeds.description: The new embeds. An empty list removes them.

thread_id.name: Thread
thread_id.description: ID of the thread if the message is in one.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Buttons under the message: a list with label, custom_id, style (primary, secondary, success, danger or link), url (for link), emoji and disabled. A click fires the event discord_hub_button. An empty list removes the buttons. Needs a bot that listens to Discord.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: ID of the message to delete.

thread_id.name: Thread
thread_id.description: ID of the thread if the message is in one.

add_reaction.name: Add reaction
add_reaction.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a message (bots only).

thread_id.name: Thread
thread_id.description: ID of the thread if the message is in one.

pin_message.name: Pin message
pin_message.description: Pins a message in its channel (bots only).

thread_id.name: Thread
thread_id.description: ID of the thread if the message is in one.

unpin_message.name: Unpin message
unpin_message.description: Removes the pin from a message (bots only).

thread_id.name: Thread
thread_id.description: ID of the thread if the message is in one.

update_thread.name: Update thread
update_thread.description: Archives, locks, unlocks or renames a thread (bots only). Returns the new state.

name.name: Name
name.description: The new name of the thread.

list_forum_tags.name: List forum tags
list_forum_tags.description: Returns the tags of a forum channel with their IDs (bots only).

respond.name: Respond
respond.description: Answers a command or a button click. The first answer to a command fills the “thinking” message, further answers are new messages. Returns the message ID.

interaction_id.name: Interaction
interaction_id.description: The interaction_id from the event of the command or button.

embeds.name: Embeds
embeds.description: A list of embeds, as for “Send message”.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Buttons under the message: a list with label, custom_id, style (primary, secondary, success, danger or link), url (for link), emoji and disabled. A click fires the event discord_hub_button. An empty list removes the buttons. Needs a bot that listens to Discord.

ephemeral.name: Only visible to the user
ephemeral.description: For further answers: only the user who used the command sees the message. The first answer to a command follows the setting of the command.

update.name: Change the message
update.description: For a button click: change the message with the button instead of sending a new answer.

nothing_to_change.message: Nothing to change: no new values were given.

too_many_buttons.message: A message can have at most {limit} buttons.

buttons_need_listening.message: Buttons only work if the bot listens to Discord. Turn on “Listen to Discord” in the options of the bot.

unknown_interaction.message: This interaction is unknown or too old. Discord allows answers for 15 minutes.

init.title: Listening to Discord
init.description: Turn this on if the bot should receive commands, button clicks and reactions from Discord. Commands you create and watched servers always turn it on. Receiving messages needs the "Message Content Intent" on the "Bot" page in the Developer Portal. Tracking member status needs the "Presence Intent" there and shows status and activity of the members you watch. The allowed users and roles (IDs) limit who may press buttons and react, an empty list allows everyone. Commands without their own list use these.

data.receive_messages: Receive messages (needs the Message Content Intent)
data.track_presence: Track member status (needs the Presence Intent)

error.invalid_ids: User and role IDs consist of digits only.

intents_missing.title: Discord refuses the intents of a bot
intents_missing.description: Discord closed the connection of {bot} because an intent is not enabled. On the "Bot" page in the Developer Portal, turn on the "Message Content Intent" (to receive messages) and the "Presence Intent" (for member status), or turn the feature off in the bot's options.

commands_not_allowed.title: Discord refuses the commands of a bot
commands_not_allowed.description: Discord refused to create the commands of {bot}. Invite the bot again with the scope “applications.commands” (OAuth2 URL Generator in the Developer Portal).
